main.description: Uploads the body, a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, as a blob of the account logged in to this appview's web pages, and names it as the picture of its dev.knotless.profile record, as `knotless account profile --avatar` does: one that is not a PNG or JPEG, or is over 1,000,000 bytes, is drawn again as a JPEG that fits, at most 2000 pixels on its longest side. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

errors.description: No picture, or one that is not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description: Sets the picture of the account logged in to this appview's pages.
